2026_02_PIT_NE.headline: Patriots protection test meets Pittsburgh’s disruptive front
2026_02_PIT_NE.paragraph1: New England enters its home opener trying to steady an offense that lacked consistency in Week 1, while Pittsburgh arrives unbeaten with another chance to turn pressure into favorable field position. The Patriots’ own preview emphasizes the home-opening setting and a familiar opponent, and Pittsburgh’s scouting piece notes how turnover swings shaped last season’s meeting. For New England, cleaner protection and ball security are the clearest route to keeping the Steelers from dictating down and distance.
2026_02_PIT_NE.model_rationale: New England’s protection and ball security against Pittsburgh’s pressure determine whether the Patriots can sustain drives without handing the Steelers favorable field position.
